lines.text: Moses asks Jethro to let him return to his brothers in Egypt, and Jethro says, "Go in peace."
Moses takes his wife and sons on a donkey, carrying the staff of God, and the LORD says He will kill Pharaoh's firstborn son.
At a lodging place, the LORD is about to kill Moses, but his brother Aaron circumcises Moses' son and the LORD lets him alone.

wrong_details.wrong: his brother Aaron circumcises Moses' son
wrong_details.true: Zipporah took a flint knife and cut off her son's foreskin

lines.text: Aaron meets Moses on the banks of the Nile and kisses him, and Moses tells him everything the LORD said.

wrong_details.wrong: on the banks of the Nile

lines.text: Aaron relays the LORD's words and Moses performs the signs before the elders and people, who believe and worship.
